title: Arimoclomol for BUB1B-MVA
subtitle: Can functional BubR1 be restored?
label: 01 / THE RESEARCH QUESTION
narration: We propose arimoclomol for laboratory testing in BUB one B related mosaic variegated aneuploidy. The aim is better chromosome separation through restoration of functional Bub R one. The key unknown is whether the N one thousand and two K variant retains function that a drug can rescue. No drug rescue has been demonstrated.

title: The candidate must beat credible alternatives
subtitle: Different evidence strengths, one unresolved functional question
label: 02 / THE COMPARISON
narration: Arimoclomol has a documented human exposure record and a conditional stress-response rationale. N M N has stronger direct evidence of increased Bub R one protein, in mouse systems. Four P B A can also increase inducible Hsp70 in a different cell model. None establishes N one thousand and two K rescue. We would compare these candidates on function and cell fate at qualified exposures. Another candidate can replace our lead.

title: The decisive experiment
subtitle: Full-length protein, matched abundance, measured function
label: 03 / THE PROPOSED TEST
narration: First, compare full-length normal and variant protein at matched abundance. Then measure segregation errors alongside division, death and arrest. Confidence bounds must clear a prespecified worthwhile benefit, with exposure and fate criteria also satisfied. A protein increase alone cannot advance the programme. The protocol includes construct specifications and public price evidence. Laboratory acceptance, imaging qualification and the complete budget remain open.
source: Functional rescue plan / laboratory readiness / proposed experiments

title: The software distinguishes three misleading signals
subtitle: Recorded executions of the delivered Python decision rules
label: 04 / THE WORKING DEMO
narration: Here are three recorded executions using synthetic inputs. In the first, protein rises forty percent, but the functional interval stays below the illustrative benefit threshold. The programme rules out that worthwhile benefit. In the second, the surviving cells look better, but selective loss triggers do not advance. In the third, exposure measurement fails, so the result is technically indeterminate. The intervals are supplied, not fitted from observations. These examples demonstrate working decision software, not experimental drug effects.
source: Three existing synthetic fixtures / replay.py / 40-case frozen software evaluation

title: A reusable gene-to-condition navigator
subtitle: Local queries with source evidence and unresolved cases visible
label: 05 / THE WORKING DEMO
narration: The offline navigator shows the source behind a gene-to-condition connection. This is the actual BUB one B lookup. Twenty-eight selected queries passed, covering forty-seven reviewed associations. That developer audit shares the tool's sources, so clinical validity remains untested. A match does not establish family eligibility. Separately, our public ranking benchmark retains all seven hundred and thirteen signatures, failures and source qualifications for inspection.
source: Frozen 28-query audit / compact public benchmark / source-label recovery

title: A credit-funded continuation with explicit outputs
subtitle: $12,000 in Claude Science credits, conditional on award terms
label: 06 / THE NEXT DELIVERABLES
narration: The credit plan funds evidence checks, public validation and reusable analysis tools, with an initial service-qualification step and spending caps. Its outputs are corrected claim records, a new evaluation registered before inference, and reproducible analysis releases. Credits do not fund the laboratory programme. What we deliver now is a testable drug proposal and working tools that expose unsupported conclusions. The next biological result must determine which candidate, if any, advances.
source: Claude Science continuation plan / eligible computation only
